_docs.purpose: Map each 2.5D feature id (from resources/js/campus-2.5d.layer.js -> L.CAMPUS_25D_DATA) to the numeric locations.id it represents. Consumed by app/services/Campus25dMapping.py. Ignored keys starting with underscore.
_docs.fallback: Buildings with no entry keep the layer's own name/label; they still render, they just don't tie back to a locations row.
